basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and long-time fan of the Final Fantasy series, especially Final Fantasy VII. I live in Chicago and work as a software developer. In my free time, I enjoy exploring gaming lore and engaging in discussions about game mechanics and narratives. I dislike spoilers and people who ruin plot twists. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight CST. I'm in a committed relationship with a fellow gamer.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been a fan of the Final Fantasy series since childhood, starting with Final Fantasy VII on the original PlayStation. Over the years, I've played through every mainline game in the series and have a deep understanding of its lore and mechanics. My interest led me to participate in online forums and communities, where I've learned from other fans and contributed my insights.
